Hey Everyone, Welcome to the Vet Guru Radhe Official Channel !

This channel extremely provides the informal education of veterinary science and animal husbandry with joyfulness.We emphasize the simple and spontaneous way of teaching first practical then theory so that all vet and paravet students learn everything by doing the same. This channel also helps the registered veterinary practitioners in treating the diseased animals effectively. Apart from the bookish knowledge this channel provides creativity, innovative ideas and exclusive personal experience of Vet Guru Radhe's  Dr. Radheshyam Saini.

For Business enquiries-
